name: New Mexico thistle
desc: New Mexico thistle (Cirsium neomexicanum): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 14 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Cirsium neomexicanum is a North American species of thistle known by the common names New Mexico thistle, powderpuff thistle, lavender thistle, foss thistle and desert thistle.
